1. Read the CSV (crime rates) and the neighbour-list file into pandas DataFrames.  
2. Identify borough rows where crime_rate_value is NaN.  
   • These boroughs are excluded from all subsequent calculations and from “data_points_used”.  
   • When a VALID borough’s neighbourhood list contains one of these NaN boroughs, simply drop the missing neighbour from that local-area sum (i.e. use only neighbours with non-missing values).  
3. For every remaining borough i:  
   a. Build a Python list containing i plus every valid neighbour j whose crime_rate_value is not NaN.  
   b. Compute local_sum_i  =  Σ crime_rate_value for all boroughs in that list.  
4. Collect the vector {local_sum_i} for all boroughs retained in Step 2.  
5. Compute the city-wide mean (μ) and sample standard deviation (σ, ddof=1) of that vector.  
   • If σ turns out to be zero (unlikely), stop: no borough can be significant.  
6. For each borough i, calculate a z-score:  z_i = (local_sum_i – μ)/σ.  
7. Tag significance:  
   • HOT spot if  z_i > +1.96 (95 % confidence) or  > +2.576 (99 %).  
   • COLD spot if z_i < –1.96 (95 %) or  < –2.576 (99 %).

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ---------- 1. Load data ----------
crime_path = "chunks_csv/getisord/getisord_crime_first_half_2011.csv"
adj_path   = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

crime_df = pd.read_csv(crime_path)        # columns: borough, crime_rate_value
adj_df   = pd.read_csv(adj_path)          # columns: borough, neighbor

# ---------- 2. Identify boroughs with valid data ----------
valid_boroughs = crime_df.dropna(subset=["crime_rate_value"]).set_index("borough")
valid_set = set(valid_boroughs.index)

# ---------- 3. Build undirected adjacency dictionary ----------
adjacency = {b: set() for b in valid_set}

for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
    b1, b2 = row["borough"], row["neighbor"]
    # add edge both ways only if the node itself has a valid crime value
    if b1 in valid_set and b2 in valid_set:
        adjacency[b1].add(b2)
        adjacency[b2].add(b1)

# ---------- 4. Compute local sums (borough + all valid neighbours) ----------
local_sums = {}
for b in valid_set:
    neighbours = adjacency[b]
    members = {b} | neighbours                    # borough plus its neighbours
    local_sums[b] = valid_boroughs.loc[list(members), "crime_rate_value"].sum()

local_sum_series = pd.Series(local_sums)

# ---------- 5. Global mean & sample std of local sums ----------
mean_local = local_sum_series.mean()
std_local  = local_sum_series.std(ddof=1)

# If std == 0 → no variation, no significant spots
if std_local == 0:
    z_scores = pd.Series(0, index=local_sum_series.index)
else:
    z_scores = (local_sum_series - mean_local) / std_local

# ---------- 6. Significance test ----------
results = []
for borough, z in z_scores.items():
    if abs(z) > 2.576:                                 # 99% confidence first
        label = "HOT" if z > 0 else "COLD"
        results.append(f"{borough} ({label}, z-score = {z})")
    elif abs(z) > 1.96:                                # else 95% confidence
        label = "HOT" if z > 0 else "COLD"
        results.append(f"{borough} ({label}, z-score = {z})")

# ---------- 7. Print outputs ----------
data_points_used = len(valid_set)
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")

if results:
    print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {', '.join(results)}")
else:
    print("FINAL ANSWER: none")
